scientific_limitations: Only geometric isomorphism over algebraically closed characteristic-two fields is classified.
Cyclic order-four subgroup is unlabelled: a chosen generator is not recorded.
Zero and infinity on the compactified parameter line are not admissible smooth covers in the stated family.
Classical genus-two Artin–Schreier isomorphism techniques and previously established automorphism group orders are acknowledged as prior work.
title: The ten-sheeted forgetful map for cyclic-quartic genus-two covers in characteristic two
